_comment: Sprint D9 — spike load scenario. Cf. d9_deep_analysis_supplement.md §1.5 (transitoire model). Step jump 1 → 16 concurrent clients at t=30 s. Total 120 s = 30 s warm + 90 s post-spike measurement window. SLO `D9-LOAD-4` requires p99 to drop back below 5 s within 30 s of the spike onset (HPA scale-up budget). The 90 s post-spike duration is calibrated so that the parser's 10 s sliding window (audit fix L21) has 80 anchors to test before declaring 'never recovered'.
_recovery_metric_extraction: The parser (parse_ghz_report.py::_ghz_spike_recovery_seconds) walks 10 s sliding windows starting at t=31 s (one second after spike onset to exclude the spike instant). The first window with p99 ≤ 5 s gives `recovery_seconds = window_start - spike_start_s`. If no window recovers, recovery_seconds = post-spike duration (forces SLO FAIL).
